title.zh: 缩短 WebKit 发布验证的数据库准备时间
title.en: Reduce WebKit release validation database setup time

purpose.zh: 复用仅含迁移结果的隔离 D1 缓存，避免每次 GitHub 发布检查都重放全部 SQL 迁移，同时保留完整页面验证。
purpose.en: Reuse an isolated migration-only D1 cache so each GitHub release check need not replay every SQL migration while preserving the complete page matrix.

zh: 为 WebKit 布局任务恢复并保存按迁移文件与依赖锁文件定址的 D1 结构缓存。
保留原有 310 组中英文页面与视口测量，每次仍生成独立登录会话和用户样本。
en: Restore and save a migration-and-lockfile-keyed D1 schema cache for the WebKit layout job.
Keep all 310 Chinese/English page and viewport measurements, with a new isolated login session and user fixture on every run.

zh: 仅影响 GitHub WebKit 发布验证的本地样本准备；线上学习、订阅和付款行为不变。
en: Only local fixture preparation in GitHub WebKit release validation; production learning, subscriptions, and payments are unchanged.

zh: 先复制迁移完成的本地 D1 结构，再插入随机会话；缓存不含真实账号、测试登录令牌或生产数据。
迁移文件或依赖锁文件变化会触发重建；缺失、未完成或指纹不符的缓存回退到完整迁移。
en: Copy the migrated local D1 schema before inserting a random session; cache neither real accounts, test login tokens, nor production data.
Rebuild when migrations or the dependency lockfile change; a missing, incomplete, or mismatched cache falls back to full migration replay.

zh: 缓存命中、失效、随机会话隔离行为测试；站点策略门禁、TypeScript、零警告 lint、全套测试与构建。
GitHub 完整 WebKit 检查通过后核对线上页面和精确 Project 发布记录。
en: Cache hit, invalidation, and random-session isolation tests; site policy gates, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, full tests, and build.
After the complete GitHub WebKit gate, inspect the production page and exact Project release record.

zh: 首次遇到新迁移键时仍须完整重建，后续命中才节省准备时间；不提交付款。
en: The first run for a new migration key still rebuilds fully; later cache hits save setup time. No payment is submitted.

zh: 仅缓存 SmartLingo 自有的本地 D1 测试结构，不复制其他站点资源。
en: Cache only SmartLingo's own local D1 test schema; copy no other site's resources.

rollback.zh: 部署上一稳定提交；数据库结构无变更。
rollback.en: Deploy the previous stable commit; no database schema change is involved.
